points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Five cases are identified as own; M0.15 inviscid, M0.15 laminar and Re200 packages are byte-identical to reference 02 and do not establish own completion.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original raw attempt passes structural validator, but three packages are reference outputs and one own steady plateau is not stable; validator pass is not numerical proof.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Three mandatory cases use reference data; own Re20 is labeled converged at 0.679 orders despite drifting force histories.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Own M2 inviscid is broadly plausible; Re20 Cd varies 2.83–3.29 in final 2000 samples and other steady plateaus have limited reductions.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Raw attempt preserves actual contestant 29-page PDF and 60 plots, but several own late drag traces are compressed; three case figures visualize reference outputs.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Historical report presents all cases as solver results, but final response labels three reference; it also claims all forces steady despite own Re20 drift.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Raw attempt manifest and plots survive, but three case packages match reference 02 and current sibling PDF is absent; curated report does not rebuild.
